items.title: ADNOC对Ruwais Diyab非常规天然气开发项目作出最终投资决定
items.title_en: ADNOC takes final investment decision on Ruwais Diyab unconventional gas development
items.sector: 非常规天然气与基础设施
items.summary: ADNOC于11月2日宣布Ruwais Diyab非常规天然气开发项目最终投资决定，目标2029年起供应每日3.45亿标准立方英尺天然气，配套现场处理设施及新管道连接阿联酋天然气网络。该阶段并非新授予EPC合同。
items.summary_en: ADNOC announced the final investment decision for Ruwais Diyab unconventional gas development on 2 November, targeting 345 million standard cubic feet of gas per day from 2029, with on-site processing and new pipelines connecting to the UAE gas network. An FID is not an EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 天然气处理与管网工程具中长期供应机会，但项目采购和供应商资质需另外核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: Gas processing and pipeline development may create supply opportunities, while actual procurement and vendor qualifications require separate verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注管道、工业机电、处理设施及工程供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track pipeline works, industrial MEP, gas processing facilities and construction supply chains.

items.title: 阿曼Mazoon铜金矿与中国Hongda签署1.61亿里亚尔十年矿业服务合同
items.title_en: Oman's Mazoon copper-gold project signs RO161 million ten-year mining services contract with China's Hongda
items.summary: 阿曼Minerals Development Oman与中国Hongda International签署Mazoon铜金矿十年矿业服务合同，价值约1.61亿阿曼里亚尔，涉及Yanqul露天矿钻探、装运、矿石运输以及矿区道路和支持设施。该合同已签，非新的公开总包招标。
items.summary_en: Minerals Development Oman signed a ten-year mining services contract worth approximately RO161 million with China's Hongda International for the Mazoon copper-gold project in Yanqul, covering drilling, loading, hauling, ore delivery, mine roads and supporting facilities. The contract has been signed and is not a new open prime tender.
items.why_it_matters: 中国承包商参与为设备、劳务及配套供应提供潜在对接渠道。
items.why_it_matters_en: Chinese contractor participation creates potential equipment, workforce and supporting-service partnership channels.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注与Hongda相关的车辆、设备、工程材料与劳务合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore equipment, fleet, construction materials and workforce opportunities alongside Hongda.

items.title: 阿曼Nama与中国国家电网就两处各500MW储能项目签框架协议
items.title_en: Oman's Nama and State Grid partner to evaluate two 500 MW battery storage projects
items.summary: Nama Holding与中国State Grid International Development就Duqm Industrial及Al-Subaikhi两处拟各500MW储能项目开展合作评估，规划接入阿曼400kV输电网络。现阶段属于框架合作，尚未披露具体EPC合同金额。
items.summary_en: Nama Holding and China's State Grid International Development agreed to evaluate two proposed 500 MW battery energy storage projects in Duqm Industrial and Al-Subaikhi, potentially connecting to Oman's 400kV transmission grid. This remains a framework and assessment phase, not a confirmed EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 项目仍待开发与技术可行性确认，后续有大型储能及电力供应链潜力。
items.why_it_matters_en: The projects remain subject to further development and feasibility work, with potential future storage and grid-supply demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注电池储能、变电站、输电设备及中国企业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor battery storage, substations, grid equipment and Chinese contractor partnerships.

items.title: 科特迪瓦Danané至利比里亚边境32.5公里道路建设启动国际招标
items.title_en: Côte d'Ivoire invites bids for 32.5 km Danané–Liberian border roads project
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月2日公布PDZTA-2道路工程国际招标，涉及Danané—Gbeunta—利比里亚边境27.5公里公路及5公里城市道路。招标期限和资质以正式文件为准。
items.summary_en: The African Development Bank published an international invitation to bid on 2 November for the PDZTA-2 roads works, covering 27.5 km from Danané via Gbeunta towards the Liberian border plus 5 km of urban roads. Eligibility and deadlines are governed by the tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 明确工程范围，属于真实采购机会，而非项目意向。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an actual procurement opportunity with a defined construction scope rather than an investment proposal.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进道路EPC、土建分包、设备及材料供货。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor road EPC, civil subcontracting, machinery and materials supply.

items.title: 贝宁科托努PAPC发布排水清淤及金属护栏工程招标
items.title_en: Benin Cotonou PAPC tenders drainage dredging and metal safety-barrier works
items.summary: 非洲开发银行支持的科托努雨水排水计划于10月30日公告采购，包括Pa2蓄洪池下游至Nokoué湖的清淤工程，以及Pa2与QaQc蓄洪池金属护栏供货和安装。
items.summary_en: The African Development Bank-backed Cotonou stormwater programme issued a procurement notice on 30 October for dredging downstream of retention basin Pa2 towards Lake Nokoué and supplying and installing metal safety barriers around basins Pa2 and QaQc.
items.why_it_matters: 属于具体可识别的市政防洪工程与金属设备采购，须以原招标文件确定投标条件。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a specified urban flood-control and metalworks procurement, with bid requirements governed by the official notice.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注水利工程、清淤设备及金属结构分包供货。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track drainage works, dredging equipment and metal fabrication or installation supply.

items.title: 沙迦机场推进约24亿迪拉姆基础设施扩建项目组合
items.title_en: Sharjah Airport advances AED2.4 billion infrastructure expansion portfolio
items.summary: 沙迦机场于11月2日展示包含机场扩建在内的约24亿迪拉姆基础设施项目组合，目标到2027年底将年客运容量提升至2500万人以上。有关金额属推进中的项目组合，非当日新授标。
items.summary_en: Sharjah Airport presented an approximately AED2.4 billion programme of infrastructure projects on 2 November, including expansion intended to raise annual passenger capacity above 25 million by the end of 2027. The value relates to ongoing projects, not a new award that day.
items.why_it_matters: 现有建设项目可持续产生运营与供应需求，但不宜标注为开放新工程总包招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: Existing construction may generate supply and service demand but should not be labelled as a new open EPC tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注机场机电、装修及航空运营配套采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor airport MEP, fit-out and aviation operations supply chains.

items.title: 富吉拉与日本JETRO讨论港口物流及供应链对接
items.title_en: Fujairah and Japan's JETRO discuss port logistics and trade delegation
items.summary: 富吉拉工业与经济部门与日本贸易振兴机构JETRO讨论推动日本企业代表团走访富吉拉港和东海岸设施，了解港口、贸易路线与物流服务。尚未签署工程合同或公布采购金额。
items.summary_en: Fujairah's industry and economy authorities and Japan External Trade Organization discussed potential Japanese business delegation visits to Fujairah Port and east-coast facilities to explore logistics, trade routes and services. No construction award or procurement value has been announced.
items.why_it_matters: 属于贸易供应链商务开发线索，不是已落实基础设施建设项目。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a trade and supply-chain development lead rather than a contracted infrastructure project.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注日本企业中东物流和供应链服务合作机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor opportunities to support Japanese companies with Middle East logistics and supply-chain services.

items.title: 阿布扎比ICAD Al Masaood Energy推进2.5MW工业太阳能设施
items.title_en: Al Masaood Energy advances 2.5 MW industrial solar facility in Abu Dhabi ICAD
items.summary: Al Masaood Energy与TotalEnergies合作推进位于阿布扎比工业城的太阳能供电运营中心，配置2.5MW工业太阳能设施，促进运营低碳化。公告未披露具体EPC合同价值或招标窗口。
items.summary_en: Al Masaood Energy is advancing a solar-powered operations facility in Abu Dhabi Industrial City with TotalEnergies, featuring a 2.5 MW solar installation to reduce operational emissions. No specific EPC contract value or open tender window was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 规模明确但属于企业设施项目进展，潜在供应环节需进一步核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a defined private-sector facility project; any available supply packages need separate confirmation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业光伏安装、配电设备与能源管理系统。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track industrial PV installation, distribution equipment and energy management systems.
